name: Anneliese Schmidt
bio:
Anneliese's path into motorsport started unconventionally, not with a racing lineage, but with a deep fascination for engineering and problem-solving. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from RWTH Aachen University, she initially worked in the automotive industry, focusing on vehicle dynamics and performance optimization. Frustrated by the slower pace of production car development, she transitioned to motorsport, joining a smaller Formula 3 team as a data analyst. Her sharp analytical skills and ability to identify crucial areas for improvement quickly propelled her through the ranks.

At Team Penske, Anneliese excels at managing the complexities of the test driver program. She meticulously plans testing schedules, oversees data collection, and ensures seamless communication between the drivers, engineers, and mechanics. Her demanding nature stems from her unwavering commitment to pushing the boundaries of performance. She is known for her ability to extract valuable insights from even the most challenging test sessions, making her an invaluable asset to the team's development efforts. Her focus on the bigger picture is a major strength, allowing her to strategically maximize the impact of testing on overall race performance.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair, often pulled back in a low ponytail during work.
physical.description: Anneliese has a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor that reflects her dedication to her role.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations and ideas.
Insists on a precisely organized workspace, with color-coded folders and labels.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
